ITRD.description: Influence Line Truss Force Data (ITRD). Returns the TRUSS AXIAL FORCE influence line of one truss element as a unit load moves along a traffic line lane. Truss members carry axial force only, so there is no component selection. Driven by LANE_NAME (the traffic line lane) and KEY_ELEM; the component is chosen via COMPONENTS. Requires moving-load (influence line) analysis results: the model must be analyzed and in post-processing state, otherwise the request FAILS with an error (e.g. 'post mode is required', 'failed to set influence data; check that the analysis has been performed', or 'no influence line data was produced') - it never returns an empty table. Response: a table named INFLL_TRUSS FORCES with columns ELEM, POSITION, DISTANCE, INFLUENCE (one row per evaluated position of the unit load along the lane) plus a SUMMARY sub-table giving the MINIMUM/MAXIMUM influence value and its DISTANCE, and the FORCE/DIST units of the values.

Argument.description: Influence Line Truss Force Data request (DTO_ITRD_REQUEST).

LANE_NAME.description: Line Lane Name. Must name an existing moving-load traffic LINE lane (only Line Lane type is accepted; other lane types fail with 'only a Line Lane can be used for influence lines').

EXPORT_PATH.description: Optional export file path; extension MUST be .txt or .json (anything else fails with 'EXPORT_PATH extension must be .txt or .json'). A .json path re-exports the returned table to that file; a .txt path writes the legacy GUI text output. The table is returned in the response either way.

UNIT.description: Optional output unit override. Omitted sub-units keep the document's current unit system; the units actually used are echoed in the response table's FORCE/DIST fields.

HEAT.description: Heat unit (case-insensitive). Not used by influence-line values; accepted for unit-system completeness.

TEMP.description: Temperature unit (case-insensitive). Not used by influence-line values; accepted for unit-system completeness.

OPT_INCLUDE_IMPACT_FACTOR.description: Include Impact Factor. If true but the active moving-load code does not support an impact factor, the request fails with 'impact factor is not supported by the current moving-load code'.

KEY_ELEM.description: Truss element number. Must exist and be a truss-type element ('the key element type does not match the requested result type' otherwise).
